primary: raw per-task events and regret; all 20 formal slots retained
binomial_assumptions: approximately independent task attempts with equal success probability and acceptable administrative cutoff; descriptive, not cross-instance or quantum superiority inference
no_binomial_interval_for: planned-slot realization as if not-started slots were random hardware trials
bootstrap_unit: complete task record including failure/pending/empty feasible set
bootstrap_statistic: conditional median of task_best_strict_regret among feasible valid tasks, plus task hit proportion
empty_conditional_subsets: count and report explicitly; no zero imputation
degenerate_all_zero_or_one: state degeneracy; binomial interval remains nonzero width
